holidays.name: Do a Grouch a Favor Day
holidays.description: Today is your chance to turn a frown upside down by doing something kind for the crankiest person you know. Bring the office curmudgeon a coffee, shovel a grumpy neighbor's walk, or leave a nice note for the cynic in your family. Bonus points if you get a reluctant smile out of them.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It has been passed around holiday calendars as a playful nudge to spread kindness to the people who seem to need it most.
holidays.funFact: Oscar the Grouch, Sesame Street's trash-can-dwelling icon, has been grumpy on TV since 1969. Some of his biggest fans say that grouchiness is secretly a form of honesty.

holidays.name: National Almond Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the crunchy, nutty, wonderfully versatile almond. Eat them roasted, salted, chocolate-covered, or blended into creamy almond butter. They also show up in marzipan, granola, and almond milk.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial food observance of unclear origin. It gives snackers a reason to toast one of the world's most popular tree nuts.
holidays.funFact: Botanically, an almond isn't a true nut. It's the seed of a fruit related to peaches and cherries. California grows the vast majority of the world's commercial almond supply.
